idea-plugin.name: Inlay Hints Extension
idea-plugin.description: Displays line-oriented notes from mirrored IHM files as clickable end-of-line inlay hints in source editors.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Use inlay-hints as the sidecar directory for IHM files.
  • Display mirrored IHM lines as clickable end-of-line inline inlays.
  • Keep sidecar line positions synchronized with editor and external source changes.
  • Restore deleted hints when source line deletions are undone or redone.
  • Optionally clear hints on modified source lines.
  • Show or hide hints from Settings | Tools | Inlay Hints Extension.
  • Open the matching IHM line with Ctrl-click while leaving ordinary clicks unchanged.
  • Edit a hint inline by typing a configurable activation keyword at the end of its source line.
  • Use a leading and trailing space around the default activation keyword: " ^^ ".
  • Save inline edits immediately on focus loss and restore the source caret after Enter.
  • Display Chinese text correctly while editing a new or existing hint inline.
  • Optionally delete an IHM file when inline editing removes its last non-empty hint.
  • Optionally remove empty IHM parent directories after automatic IHM file deletion.
  • Save IHM documents with the write access required by recent IntelliJ Platform versions.
  • Create a line-aligned IHM file automatically when inline editing is activated for a new source file.
  • Support source files from multiple language and source-set directories.
  • Use UTF-8 and the IDE inlay color scheme for hint text.
  • Build with the IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x for current IDE compatibility.
